_comment: TIME axis presets for the decoupled Sun & Light system (Stage 2). Each = a sun day-arc: time_of_day (h), the daylight window (sunrise/sunset), peak sun elevation at noon, and the sunrise→sunset azimuth sweep. The SKY/sun-color/ambient are produced by the GPU-compute atmosphere (not stored here). Task 3 fills this from the 6 moods' sun positions.
